profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a seasoned software engineer with significant experience in:
 * Programming language runtime internals.
 * Open source development and open source community leadership.
 * Large scale build systems.
 * Information security & practical applied cryptography -- I don't claim to be an infosec _expert_ as this is not my primary field, but I have a good sense or what to and not to do before calling on the dedicated experts for serious review.
 * Network programming and debugging.
 * Software development ranging from high level application logic to low level kernel programming.

Specialties: Python internals, infrastructure & system programming, developer productivity, network programming, computer architecture, distributed systems, and test automation.

I originally started my career with a system and network design, administration, and automation background.

positions.title: Steering Council Member (elected)
positions.description: What an amazing four years to serve. We aided the expansion of our PSF managed Developers In Residence program into a team spanning multiple areas of expertise and saw Free Threading Python turn into reality.
